194117c7558f79ef.description: Purpose : The Safety Officer is responsible for implementing, monitoring, and enforcing health, safety, and environmental (HSE) policies to ensure a safe and compliant working environment. The role ensures adherence to company safety standards and local regulatory requirements while promoting a strong safety culture across the organization. Responsibilities: 1. Safety Compliance & Implementation Ensure compliance with local occupational health and safety regulations and company policies. Conduct regular site inspections to identify hazards, unsafe acts, and unsafe conditions. Monitor adherence to safety procedures and safe work practices. 2. Risk Assessment & Hazard Control Conduct risk assessments and Job Safety Analysis (JSA). Recommend corrective and preventive actions to mitigate risks. Strong reporting and documentation abilities. Good communication and training skills. Ability to influence and promote a safety culture. Problem-solving and analytical skills.

1936a77a80d4b5f3.job_title: Principal Specialist Data Science & Artificial Intelligence
1936a77a80d4b5f3.description: About Ma'aden and the Role Ma'aden, established in 1997, is a rapidly expanding multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. It plays a key role in developing Saudi Arabia's mining industry. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, is for a Principal Specialist in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence within the Agentic AI department. The specialist will lead advanced data science and analytics initiatives, translating business challenges into scalable analytical solutions, AI-enabled insights, predictive models, and decision intelligence products. Key Responsibilities Translate business priorities and operational challenges into clear data science problem statements, analytical approaches, and measurable outcomes. Design and deliver predictive, prescriptive, diagnostic, and exploratory analytics solutions to support decision-making across business and operational domains. Develop machine learning models, statistical analyses, simulations, optimization approaches, and advanced analytics products using enterprise data assets. Support the development of agentic AI use cases by defining data, model, workflow, evaluation, and decision-support requirements. Collaborate with AI engineers, platform teams, data engineers, and business stakeholders to embed analytics and machine learning into autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. Create reusable analytical assets, data science patterns, feature logic, model components, and decision intelligence products that can scale across business domains. Partner with data platform, governance, and architecture teams to ensure data products are trusted, well-documented, reusable, and operationally maintainable. Apply appropriate data science governance practices for model validation, performance monitoring, bias checks, versioning, deployment readiness, and lifecycle management. Provide expert guidance to analysts, data scientists, engineers, and business teams on analytical methods, model design, evaluation, and adoption. Advise stakeholders on what analytics or AI can realistically solve, required data readiness, implementation complexity, and expected value. Model Quality and Governance The role involves defining evaluation approaches for AI-enabled insights, model performance, business impact, human oversight, and continuous improvement. This includes promoting responsible use of agentic AI by ensuring transparency, explainability, control, auditability, and fit-for-purpose model deployment. The specialist will also define success measures, impact metrics, adoption criteria, and benefit tracking approaches for analytics and AI-enabled solutions, ensuring compliance with data governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and responsible AI expectations. Data Product Advancement This position is responsible for integrating analytics into dashboards, workflows, applications, copilots, and AI agents where decision support can improve speed, quality, and productivity. Maintaining clear documentation covering assumptions, data sources, model logic, limitations, controls, and expected business usage is also a key aspect of this role. Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Advisory The Principal Specialist will review analytical designs, model outputs, assumptions, and recommendations to ensure technical quality and business relevance. Effective communication of insights, risks, limitations, and recommended actions to technical, operational, and executive stakeholders is essential. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of relevant experience in data science and artificial intelligence. Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into clear data science use cases and analytical approaches. Experience in delivering predictive, prescriptive, and decision intelligence solutions with strong technical quality and business relevance. Proficiency in supporting Agentic AI use cases with trusted data, robust models, evaluation methods, and controls. Capability to ensure analytics and AI products are reusable, documented, governed, monitored, and aligned with responsible AI expectations.

With more than 89,000 employees, we operate a network of more than 2,600 offices and laboratories around the world. Oversee commissioning of HV/MV/LV electrical systems, substations, transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, ATS and critical power distribution. Conduct and coordinate black-building tests and electrical system reliability testing. Verify protection relay testing, electrical protection coordination, system redundancy and operational resilience. Coordinate with mechanical, BMS, EPMS, fire and life safety, ICT and other commissioning teams to ensure integrated system performance. Manage commissioning issues, technical investigations, corrective actions, test records and final handover documentation. Ensure compliance with project specifications, applicable electrical standards, safety procedures and Data Center reliability requirements. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognised university. Minimum 12 years of relevant professional experience in electrical engineering, testing and commissioning. Demonstrated hands-on experience commissioning Tier III / Tier IV or hyperscale Data Centers . Strong knowledge of HV/MV/LV electrical infrastructure, substations, transformers, switchgear, UPS, generators and ATS. Practical experience in Integrated Systems Testing, electrical failure simulations, load transfers and black-building testing. 191c9d6ec8f2a117.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات السعودي الايطالي لطب الاسنان عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم رعاية أسنان شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من التشخيص وحتى تنفيذ الخطط العلاجية ومتابعتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى طبيب الأسنان العام مسؤولية مجموعة واسعة من المهام السريرية والإدارية لضمان صحة الفم والأسنان للمرضى. تشمل هذه المسؤوليات ما يلي: تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بعد إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة وتحليل الصور الشعاعية، وإعداد الخطط العلاجية المناسبة والجداول الزمنية لها. إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة، بما في ذلك تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية، وتحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، بالإضافة إلى إجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى ووصف العلاجات والأدوية الضرورية. مواكبة التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان وتطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل لتحسين جودة الرعاية المقدمة. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء جميع الإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة وجراحات الفم الصغرى. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة العامة والمهنية في بيئة العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن بيئة عيادة أسنان متخصصة في المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزامًا بتقديم رعاية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.
